company.channels_supplied: Food professionals: restaurants, caterers and independent food shops, ordered online with delivery.
company.sf_brands_carried: Organic and health food lines listed; specific sugar free brands not confirmed.

company.name: Benoit Ciné Distribution (Benoit Promotion)
company.distributes: Confectionery, beverages, popcorn and candyfloss (own production) and concession equipment for cinemas and venues.
company.channels_supplied: Cinema chains Gaumont Pathé, UGC and CGR, independent cinemas, concert halls and stadiums; group also owns convenience wholesaler Supergroup.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 1994 in Lyon; supplies Gaumont Pathé, UGC and CGR cinemas plus stadiums and concert halls.
Owners took over national proximity wholesaler Supergroup from Logista France in 2022.
company.fit_rationale: Lyon based, family controlled distributor that already buys and resells confectionery into national cinema and venue concessions, a channel where a sugar free option is a clear point of difference. Through its 2022 takeover of Supergroup the same owners reach tobacconists, bakeries and groceries across France. Note it also makes its own popcorn, so it is part brand owner.

company.name: EpiSaveurs (Groupe Pomona)
company.distributes: Ambient grocery, beverages, equipment and hygiene products for foodservice.
company.channels_supplied: Restaurants, canteens, bakeries and butchers; regional branch at Saint-Quentin-Fallavier serving the Lyon area and the Alps.
what_they_do_well: Pomona group has over 5.5 billion euros revenue and nearly 80 regional sites in France and Spain.
company.fit_rationale: Pomona's ambient network has a branch on the Lyon logistics belt and reaches bakeries and catering, where sugar free biscuits and sweets suit healthier menus. Buying is largely national, so expect a longer listing process. Head office location is assumed from group materials and should be checked.

company.name: Promocash Lyon (franchise)
company.distributes: Cash and carry food wholesale for restaurants: grocery, fresh, drinks and wine (9,000 to 13,000 references per store).
company.channels_supplied: Restaurant and food professionals via store, drive, online ordering and half day delivery; Carrefour group banner.
what_they_do_well: Lyon stores renovated in 2020 with drive, online ordering and half day delivery.
company.fit_rationale: Franchisee run cash and carry where a local manager has some say on range, giving a reachable trade outlet in Lyon. The Gerland site may have closed (Metro opened there in 2022); Lyon Champagne is confirmed as of 2020.

company.name: Relais Vert
company.distributes: Organic grocery, dry goods, fruit and vegetables and natural cosmetics (8,000+ references).
company.channels_supplied: Independent organic and health food shops across France with 24 hour delivery.
company.sf_brands_carried: Organic and health food range; sugar free brands not confirmed.
what_they_do_well: Family owned and independent organic wholesaler since 1986 with 270 employees.
company.fit_rationale: Family owned national wholesaler into health food shops, an audience for sugar free snacks. Its range is organic only, so it only fits if Diablo can offer organic lines. Lyon is served through national delivery, not a local depot.
